stem: Which topic comes after Specific GI Conditions in the gastroenterology chapter sequence?
explanation: Jaundice in children is the next topic after Specific GI Conditions in the gastroenterology chapter sequence.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 1

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because gastroenteritis appears earlier in the chapter sequence.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because chronic gastrointestinal conditions in children appears before Specific GI Conditions.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because diarrhoea and malabsorption appears before Specific GI Conditions.
optionExplanations.D: Correct because the chapter sequence shows Jaundice in children immediately after Specific GI Conditions.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because food allergy is not the next topic after Specific GI Conditions in the sequence shown.
